figures.alt: A continuous interval of pole heights is positive for the complete cubic Weil form. Four moving intervals provide actual critical zeros; a signed contribution chart shows the exact positive lower contribution exceeds the bound for every unverified reflected zero. The selected zero locations are not fabricated.

figures.alt: Twenty isolated positive generalized eigenvalues, four at each of the five actual certified pole heights, are shown on a log axis in the original target norm. Four exact zero directions per pole are explicitly shown separately. There is no inferred curve between the points, and the source metric is not assigned numerical conductor moments.

The four graph directions are precisely the full arithmetic kernel throughout the proved continuous interval. The unique original minimum lift is shown with its distinct source and target norms and the exact conductor arrow between them.
